walkthrough.title: From a campaign to a conversation.

steps.label: Send the campaign
steps.agent: Hi Priya, our new collection is in. Which size are you looking for?
steps.note: A WhatsApp campaign goes to customers with a tag such as returning customer.

steps.label: Answer the reply
steps.agent: Medium is in stock. Here is the link to check out.
steps.note: Replies go to your agent instead of a dead end.

steps.label: Catch comments too
steps.agent: Thanks for your comment. I have sent the details to your DMs.
steps.note: Instagram comments with a keyword start a DM.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: A single WhatsApp campaign can currently go to up to 1,000 people.
Instagram broadcast campaigns are not available.

faq.title: Questions about the AI marketing agent.

items.q: What happens when someone replies to a campaign?
items.a: The reply goes to the agent you chose, which answers from your information. Your team sees it in the shared inbox.
AI assist can help write templates and check them against Meta’s category rules before you submit them.
